review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Key Responsibilities Partnerships & supplier network Develop relationships with MNOs, aggregators, SMS hubs and messaging providers. Maintain regular communication with carriers and partners. Maintain supplier and partnership records in CRM. Coordinate with Account Management on customer requirements and destination needs. Requirements Must have 5+ years of experience in telecom, A2P messaging, SMS wholesale, CPaaS or carrier relations.
eligibility_evidence: The company was founded within a software group with 15+ years of enterprise delivery, and today has a team of 41 across 14 nationalities, with offices in Dubai (commercial HQ and carrier relations desk), Riyadh (enterprise and regulatory), and Cairo (engineering and the 24×7 NOC).

You source and evaluate A2P routes, negotiate pricing and terms, and expand international connectivity, working with Routing and Operations on testing and quality and with Account Management on customer destination needs.
Strong knowledge of the A2P ecosystem and international connectivity.
